hardness_axes.name: Discover
hardness_axes.reasoning: Symptoms-only framing hides which subsystem breaks invariants; the agent must run reconnect/replay/resume scenarios, diff traces, and read serialization/prediction/RNG paths to localize drift. Nothing in an honest instruction can name the defective interaction without becoming cause-revealing.

hardness_axes.name: Synthesize
hardness_axes.reasoning: Coherent diagnosis requires connecting replay codec invariants, input prediction/rollback windows, RNG snapshot boundaries, and reconnect join semantics; no single module owns the failure mode end-to-end.

hardness_axes.name: Diagnose
hardness_axes.reasoning: Public contract stays at observable divergence (hashes/traces diverge after resume/reconnect while straight-through matches agree); causes are inferred from cross-run evidence, not stated as a broken function or field.

hardness_axes.name: Navigate coupling
hardness_axes.reasoning: Naive fixes risk restoring one path while breaking replay compatibility, checksum-stable exports, or rollback safety; the agent must preserve multi-scenario contracts simultaneously, not patch a single call site in isolation.

hardness_axes.name: Reason beyond training
hardness_axes.reasoning: Although rollback netcode is familiar in the abstract, this failure mode depends on timing- and ordering-sensitive interactions between predicted-input correction, snapshot boundaries, and serialized state—not a drop-in GGPO checklist.

anti_trivialization_checks.name: Disclosure-collapse
anti_trivialization_checks.reasoning: An honest symptoms-only prompt does not enumerate the exact defect cluster; residual work remains tracing cross-cutting state flow. Stating every checked invariant verbatim would widen the prompt toward spec-implementation, but that is an authoring failure mode, not the intended design.

anti_trivialization_checks.name: Hidden-instance
anti_trivialization_checks.reasoning: Hardness does not rely on picking one corrupted artifact among many; divergence must reproduce across seeded reconnect/replay matrices, so the agent cannot win by identifying a single magic record.

anti_trivialization_checks.name: Single-artifact repair
anti_trivialization_checks.reasoning: A careless implementation could still collapse to one omitted serialized field or one RNG reseed bug; authoring must deliberately split defects across codec, prediction reconciliation, and reconnect join logic so no single-file flip clears the matrix.

anti_trivialization_checks.name: Generalization
anti_trivialization_checks.reasoning: Verifier intent spans multiple seeds and scenarios (disconnect/reconnect, prediction rollback stress, export/import, resume), so solutions must generalize rather than fitting one demo match.

anti_trivialization_checks.name: Prompt-honesty
anti_trivialization_checks.reasoning: Staying honest at symptoms-only does not shrink the search space to a named broken instance; naming the precise subsystem would be cause-revealing and is excluded from the public contract.

anti_trivialization_checks.name: Cheating-vs-difficulty
anti_trivialization_checks.reasoning: Difficulty must come from real coupling and invariants, not from hiding logs or banning debug tools; tests grade deterministic state hashes and traces, not process.

anti_trivialization_checks.name: Mechanical-fix filter
anti_trivialization_checks.reasoning: Task weakness is not verifier plumbing; the conceptual risk is design collapse into a trivial seed/field omission, which is substantive rather than mechanical.

anti_trivialization_checks.name: Localized-fix
anti_trivialization_checks.reasoning: If the seeded bug lands in one obvious serializer function, the map from symptom to edit becomes too direct; environment design must distribute subtle ordering/consistency mistakes across interacting layers.

anti_trivialization_checks.name: Oracle-locality
anti_trivialization_checks.reasoning: Until the repo exists, oracle risk is whole-file rewrites of a few small netcode files; Step 2b should structure modules and fixtures so the oracle performs coordinated, multi-file semantic edits rather than one-shot replacements.

anti_trivialization_checks.name: Small declarative-cluster
anti_trivialization_checks.reasoning: The solve is not primarily editing one manifest/table; it is behavioral reconciliation across simulation, networking, and persistence codecs with executable evidence.

anti_trivialization_checks.name: Grep-collapse
anti_trivialization_checks.reasoning: Neutral subsystem names and symptom-level instructions avoid letting prompt nouns grep straight to a uniquely labeled broken block; defects should read as plausible engineering mistakes, not keywords copied from the prompt.

anti_trivialization_checks.name: Pre-factored-helper
anti_trivialization_checks.reasoning: Avoid helpers whose names mirror instruction bullets (e.g., 'ensureDeterminism'); keep responsibilities named like production code so completion is not stub-filling.

anti_trivialization_checks.name: Recipe-discount
anti_trivialization_checks.reasoning: Deterministic lockstep/rollback patterns are well-trodden; hardness must come from interaction bugs and ordering subtleties, not from reciting textbook snapshot rules from memory.

anti_trivialization_checks.name: Security-aura discount
anti_trivialization_checks.reasoning: No security theater inflation; difficulty is ordinary multiplayer engineering integrity under stress paths.

anti_trivialization_checks.name: Orthogonal-checklist
anti_trivialization_checks.reasoning: Fixes trade off replay byte-compatibility vs live resync vs prediction correction; independent knob tweaks should fail at least one matrix cell, forcing integrated reasoning rather than a linear checklist.

anti_trivialization_checks.name: Harness-discount
anti_trivialization_checks.reasoning: Multi-seed matrices add realism but are not substitutes for intellectual work; the harness exposes divergence signals, not answers.

anti_trivialization_checks.name: One-pass solvability
anti_trivialization_checks.reasoning: A senior netcode engineer might converge quickly once the right files are open; mitigate via multiple coupled defects, neutral naming, and tests that fail on partial fixes.

anti_trivialization_checks.name: Hard-only gate
anti_trivialization_checks.reasoning: As an idea family it is plausibly hard, but empirical hardness requires verifier-backed trials; until then, treat as a strong candidate with collapse risk, not a proven sub-20% frontier outcome.

anti_trivialization_checks.name: Information delta test
anti_trivialization_checks.reasoning: At least three non-obvious codebase discoveries are required to explain the divergence (see information_delta); these are not derivable from symptoms-only instruction text alone.

anti_trivialization_checks.name: Instruction specificity test
anti_trivialization_checks.reasoning: The honest public contract stays at symptoms-only (divergence under reconnect/replay resume with straight-through agreement), which is the required level for a hard-only candidate.

rubric_axes.name: Verifiable
rubric_axes.reasoning: Seeded headless matches with deterministic state hashing and golden trace slices provide objective pass/fail without subjective grading.

rubric_axes.name: Well-specified
rubric_axes.reasoning: Two implementers can agree on scenario matrix, hash inputs, and replay round-trip contracts while keeping player-facing prose minimal and symptoms-oriented.

rubric_axes.name: Solvable
rubric_axes.reasoning: An expert can bound the failure to a finite interaction surface (netcode + replay + RNG snapshots) within a contained synthetic game engine module set.

rubric_axes.name: Difficult
rubric_axes.reasoning: Conceptually strong, but easy collapse into a single-field bug makes realized difficulty sensitive to authoring fidelity until partial-oracle and trials prove discrimination.

rubric_axes.name: Interesting
rubric_axes.reasoning: Production multiplayer teams routinely pay for determinism under reconnect and replay tooling; the scenario has direct economic value.

rubric_axes.name: Outcome-verified
rubric_axes.reasoning: Grade end-state hashes/traces and replay compatibility, not tool usage or patch style.

instruction_completeness_test.reasoning: Symptoms-only instructions cannot specify the cross-layer ordering mistakes needed to fix divergence; the agent must execute the codebase and harness scenarios, so instruction alone is insufficient.

information_delta.item: Which subsystem breaks first depends on frame-aligned vs tick-aligned snapshot boundaries relative to predicted remote inputs—visible only by comparing rollback windows against serialized checkpoint timestamps in the sim loop.
information_delta.why_non_trivial: The instruction can state hashes diverge without revealing whether snapshots are cut mid-pipeline or after input merge; resolving it requires reading scheduling and buffer lifetimes, not grepping error strings.

information_delta.item: Replay resume desync traces to a mismatch between on-wire input timeline reconstruction and local prediction reconciliation after partial round-trip through the replay codec (field presence vs semantic defaults).
information_delta.why_non_trivial: Symptoms look like generic 'RNG drift' until the agent proves RNG streams match while input streams diverge; that discrimination needs reading encode/decode paths and defaulting rules.

information_delta.item: Reconnect join uses a fast-forward catch-up path that reuses RNG draw counters differently than the steady-state session loop, so identical post-reconnect inputs yield different draws even when seeds match on paper.
information_delta.why_non_trivial: Seed literals can be equal across branches while consumption order differs; discovering it requires tracing call order through catch-up vs normal tick, not inspecting a single constant.

instruction_specificity.reasoning: Public-facing description should report deterministic straight-through play vs divergence after reconnect/replay resume, plus required artifacts (hashes/traces), without naming the broken function, missing field, or branch condition.

attack_path.summary: A strong agent could still win quickly if defects are shallow or names leak intent; the main exploit is oracle-local single-hunk fixes once the right file is opened.
attack_path.reasoning: Mitigations: neutral module naming, multiple coupled mistakes, property-style assertions over scenario matrices, and partial-oracle gates so one-line RNG reseeds or one serializer field cannot satisfy every test simultaneously.

smallest_plausible_patch.summary: One-line or single-field changes remain plausible if authoring slips—this is the primary collapse mode.
smallest_plausible_patch.reasoning: Smallest successful real-world patch might be adjusting when RNG is advanced relative to input merge, adding one omitted replay field, or tightening a reconnect catch-up guard; Step 2b must ensure the minimal patch that actually fixes all scenarios is wider than that through deliberate coupling.

collapse_audit.reasoning: The idea family is structurally aligned with hard debugging (symptoms-only, cross-layer), but pre-implementation collapse risk is high if the seeded bug is localized, grepable, or textbook-recipe-shaped.
collapse_audit.residual_hardness: After a faithful multi-module toy engine exists, residual work is reconciling incompatible abstractions across replay bytes, prediction rollback, and reconnect timing so all scenario hashes agree—integration debugging, not spec transcription.
red_flags: Over-familiar rollback recipes reducing reason-beyond-training leverage
Oracle whole-file locality if modules stay tiny
